bridgeTokenPlaceholder: Copy the token from the Bridge terminal
settingNotebookDescription: Only documents in this notebook are scanned. Mark posts with blog.status=published or pending.
settingOutputDirectoryDescription: Set a separate blog project folder for Windows and macOS. Folder names sync with SiYuan settings; actual folder permissions stay on each computer, so choose a folder once on each system.
directoryNeedsAuthorizationSummary: Recorded as {directory}; grant access again on this computer
directoryChooseOnPlatformSummary: Choose a folder on a computer running this system
directoryPickerUnavailable: Folder access is unavailable in this environment. Use the Bridge fallback below.
directorySelected: Granted access to the local blog folder: {directory}
directorySelectFailed: Could not select the blog folder: {error}
directoryStorageFailed: Could not read the saved local folder permission: {error}
directoryPickerInstructions: Choose the blog project root once on each computer. If the system asks again, allow read and write access.
chooseDirectoryBeforeScan: Choose a local blog project folder before scanning and syncing documents.
directorySelectFirst: Choose the blog project folder and grant access first.
directoryPermissionRequired: Read and write access to the blog folder is required. Click Scan or Sync again and grant access when prompted.
settingContentDirDescription: Relative to the selected blog project root; defaults to Astro's src/content/blog.
settingAssetDirDescription: Relative to the selected blog project root; defaults to public/images/blog.
settingBridgeUrlDescription: Fallback only: use this if folder selection is unavailable in the current environment.
settingBridgeTokenDescription: Fallback only: copy the token printed by Bridge. Direct folder sync does not need Bridge or a token.
settingBridgeFallbackDescription: Usually not needed. Configure Bridge only when folder access is unavailable in the current environment.
settingDefaultCategoryDescription: Used when a document has no category. You can adjust categories per post or in bulk in the publisher.
settingCategoriesDescription: Add or remove category options shown in the publisher. A selected category is saved to the SiYuan custom-blog-category attribute.
settingIncludeTitleTitle: Show the post title at the top of the body
settingIncludeTitleDescription: Off by default. The first duplicate H1 is removed; turn this on to keep a title at the top of the body.
emptyScan: No scan results yet. Select a publishing notebook and click Scan.
categorySelectTitle: Changes are saved to the SiYuan custom-blog-category attribute immediately
documentCategorySaved: Set {title} to {category} and saved it to the SiYuan document attribute.
bulkCategorySaved: Set {count} documents to {category} and saved the SiYuan document attributes.
bulkCategorySaveFailed: Saved the category for {saved}/{total} documents; the rest failed: {error}
selectNotebookFirst: Select a publishing notebook in plugin settings first.
scanningDocuments: Scanning documents and preparing Markdown previews…
bridgeUnavailableHint: ; sync target status is unavailable, but preview still works. Hover here for details
missingPublicationDate: Post {title} has no publication date in its sync content.
bulkCategoryTitle: Set a category for selected posts
applyCategoryTitle: The category is saved to the SiYuan document attribute immediately
settingWindowsPathDescription: Bridge fallback only. Direct folder sync selects a separate folder on each computer.
settingMacPathDescription: Bridge fallback only. Direct folder sync selects a separate folder on each computer.
bridgeCommandReminderBefore: If Bridge is not running, run this in a terminal opened in the plugin folder:
bridgeCommandReminderAfter: Keep the terminal open while syncing. Press Ctrl+C when finished to stop Bridge.
detectingBridgePlatform: The Bridge will detect this computer and choose its configured path when scanning.
bridgeNeedsRestart: The Bridge is out of date. Stop the running local-bridge.js process and start it again.
unsupportedBridgePlatform: This computer is not supported for automatic path selection: {platform}. Configure and use Windows or macOS.
configurePlatformPath: Enter the {platform} blog repository path in plugin settings first.
configurePlatformPathsFirst: Enter the Windows and/or macOS blog repository path in plugin settings first.
